guardrails: No mass redirect from legacy apartment detail URLs to /rostov-na-donu/kvartiry/.
No redirect through /obekty/ or any other intermediate route.
A detail URL may redirect only after exact property entity lookup/lifecycle proof resolves a canonical /kvartiry/{semantic}-{publicUrlId}/ target.
Unresolved legacy detail URLs stay isolated as 404 in client mode and require future explicit per-entity decision.

decisions.publicAction: 301 via siteProfile.legacyRoutes
decisions.reason: Approved category-level legacy root redirect already exists as an explicit profile row; not used for detail URLs.
